description: Rounding each line with binary floats lands on the wrong side of half a cent for some prices; the drift is the cents per line times the lines.
The set of UTC offsets the sources use over a year, daylight saving included; more than one makes a naive local time ambiguous.
A `json.JSONEncoder` subclass whose `default` converts the types it knows and raises `TypeError` for the rest.
Size limits apply to the encoded body: `len(text.encode("utf-8"))`, where an accented letter takes two bytes.
Write a temporary file in the same folder and `os.replace` it onto the final name, so readers never see a partial file.
Architecture Decision Record: context, decision, alternatives considered and consequences.
